map.总体方差用每个观测值与总体均值 μ 的离差平方和除以总体个数 N，描述全体数据的: Population variance divides the sum of squared deviations of every observation from the population mean mu by the population size N, describing the dispersion of the whole data set. Unlike the sample variance, its denominator is N rather than n - 1, and it applies when you have all the population data.

map.用样本均值估计会系统性低估，除 n−1 是无偏修正（Bessel 校正）。: Estimating with the sample mean systematically underestimates; dividing by n-1 is the unbiased correction (Bessel's correction).
